assets.name: dianwei-v1.png
assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original character bust for a Korean Three Kingdoms roguelite army battle UI. Subject: Dian Wei, a mature broad-shouldered Chinese guard general, powerful stocky physique, weathered distinctive face, short dark beard, serious protective expression, late Eastern Han inspired iron lamellar armor with indigo cloth and worn leather, one restrained halberd handle visible. Style: polished cinematic painted historical game illustration with credible anatomy and detailed fabric/metal, independent character design; no imitation of any commercial game or named artist. Composition: single half-body portrait from head to waist, centered, no cropped head or shoulders, frontal three-quarter facing right, reads clearly at 100px tall; transparent background with clean alpha and no shadows behind canvas. Lighting: soft cold rimlight, warm face highlights. No text, letters, symbols, logos, interface, extra characters, excessive violence. Single illustration, not sprite sheet. Prefer portrait canvas 1024x1536.
